title: Fast Car
description: 《Fast Car》描寫一個人渴望逃離貧困與家庭困境，卻在追尋幸福的過程中逐漸失去希望的故事。歌中的主角因父親酗酒而被迫放棄學業，承擔照顧家庭的責任。她原本相信，只要與心愛的人一起離開，就能重新開始，建立更美好的生活。然而，現實中的經濟壓力與伴侶的逃避責任，令她再次陷入熟悉的困境，曾經的夢想也逐漸破滅。歌曲中的快車象徵自由、希望與改變命運的機會，卻也見證了理想與現實的落差。最終，《Fast Car》傳達的是對貧困、家庭責任與人生選擇的深刻反思：即使努力追尋更好的未來，也可能難以擺脫過去的束縛，而真正令人心酸的，是曾經充滿希望的夢想，最終只能化為無奈與遺憾。

translations.english: You got a fast car
translations.chinese: 你有一輛跑得飛快的車

translations.english: I want a ticket to anywhere
translations.chinese: 我只想要一張能帶我去任何地方的車票

translations.english: Maybe we make a deal
translations.chinese: 或許我們可以達成一個約定

translations.english: Maybe together we can get somewhere
translations.chinese: 或許只要我們在一起，就能闖出一片天地

translations.english: Any place is better
translations.chinese: 無論去哪裡，都會比這裡更好

translations.english: Starting from zero got nothing to lose
translations.chinese: 反正一無所有，從零開始也沒什麼可失去的

translations.english: Maybe we'll make something
translations.chinese: 或許我們能一起闖出些名堂

translations.english: Me myself I got nothing to prove
translations.chinese: 至於我，已沒有什麼需要向誰證明

translations.english: You got a fast car
translations.chinese: 你有一輛跑得飛快的車

translations.english: I got a plan to get us out of here
translations.chinese: 而我有個計畫，能帶我們逃離這個地方

translations.english: I been working at the convenience store
translations.chinese: 我一直在便利商店工作

translations.english: Managed to save just a little bit of money
translations.chinese: 好不容易才存下了一點錢

translations.english: Won't have to drive too far
translations.chinese: 我們不必開得太遠

translations.english: Just 'cross the border and into the city
translations.chinese: 只要越過邊界，進到城裡就好

translations.english: You and I can both get jobs
translations.chinese: 你和我都能找到工作

translations.english: And finally see what it means to be living
translations.chinese: 終於體會到，什麼才是真正的生活

translations.english: See my old man's got a problem
translations.chinese: 你知道嗎，我父親有個難以擺脫的問題

translations.english: He live with the bottle that's the way it is
translations.chinese: 他整天與酒瓶為伴，生活就是這副模樣

translations.english: He says his body's too old for working
translations.chinese: 他說自己的身體已經老得無法工作

translations.english: His body's too young to look like his
translations.chinese: 可他明明還年輕，身體卻已衰敗得不像話

translations.english: My mama went off and left him
translations.chinese: 我母親離開了他，頭也不回地走了

translations.english: She wanted more from life than he could give
translations.chinese: 她渴望的生活，遠遠超過他所能給予的

translations.english: I said somebody's got to take care of him
translations.chinese: 我心想，總得有人留下來照顧他

translations.english: So I quit school and that's what I did
translations.chinese: 於是我輟了學，真的留下來照顧他

translations.english: You got a fast car
translations.chinese: 你有一輛跑得飛快的車

translations.english: Is it fast enough so we can fly away?
translations.chinese: 它夠快嗎？能帶著我們遠走高飛嗎？

translations.english: We gotta make a decision
translations.chinese: 我們必須作出決定

translations.english: Leave tonight or live and die this way
translations.chinese: 要麼今晚就離開，要麼一輩子困在這樣的生活裡，直到死去

translations.chinese: 還記得嗎？那時我們開著你的車，一路飛馳

translations.chinese: 車速快得讓我彷彿醉了一般

translations.chinese: 那一刻，我感覺自己終於有了歸屬

translations.chinese: 我感覺自己終於能活出個樣子，成為一個有出息的人，真正活出自己

vocabulary.usage: 當兩個人討論後，同意交換或一起做某件事時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Make a deal」？
options: I made a deal with my sandwich, but it did not answer.
My brother and I made a deal: I wash the cups, and he cleans the table.
She made a deal the bus to go faster.
We made a deal of water because we were thirsty.
vocabulary.explanation: — 正確：兩人說好各自負責一項工作。
optionExplanations: — 錯誤：三明治不能和人商量並達成協議。
— 正確：兩人說好各自負責一項工作。
— 錯誤：這裡缺少 with，而且公車不是談條件的對象。
— 錯誤：喝水不能用 make a deal 表達。

vocabulary.meaning: 有所進展、取得成果；到達某處
vocabulary.usage: 談努力有成果，或真的到達某個地方時使用。
options: I get somewhere my shoes every day.
The soup got somewhere because it was too hot.
She got somewhere her pencil in her bag.
We studied every day, and now we are finally getting somewhere.
vocabulary.explanation: — 正確：每天學習後終於有進步。
optionExplanations: — 錯誤：不能用 get somewhere 表達穿鞋。
— 錯誤：湯很燙與取得進展沒有關係。
— 錯誤：這不能表示把筆放進包包。
— 正確：每天學習後終於有進步。

vocabulary.meaning: 沒什麼可失去的、可以放手試試
vocabulary.usage: 想嘗試一件風險不大、即使失敗也不會失去什麼的事時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Nothing to lose」？
options: I have nothing to lose, so I must buy three new shoes.
The game is free, so I have nothing to lose by trying it.
My dog has nothing to lose because he lost his ball yesterday.
There is nothing to lose on the ceiling, so I need a ladder.
vocabulary.explanation: — 正確：遊戲免費，嘗試不會有明顯損失。
optionExplanations: — 錯誤：買鞋會花錢，句子未說明為何沒有損失。
— 正確：遊戲免費，嘗試不會有明顯損失。
— 錯誤：這裡混淆字面上遺失東西與慣用語。
— 錯誤：這不是形容願意冒險嘗試的情況。

vocabulary.usage: 當你不想為了讓別人認同而展示自己的能力或價值時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Nothing to prove」？
options: My teacher has nothing to prove because the classroom has no windows.
There is nothing to prove in my soup, so I add salt.
I have nothing to prove, so I can enjoy singing even if I am not the best.
She has nothing to prove her bike to the shop.
vocabulary.explanation: — 正確：不必向別人證明自己最厲害。
optionExplanations: — 錯誤：教室沒有窗戶與是否需要證明自己無關。
— 錯誤：這個片語不能表示湯少了材料。
— 正確：不必向別人證明自己最厲害。
— 錯誤：不能這樣使用 prove 來表示騎車去商店。

vocabulary.meaning: 設法做到、好不容易成功
vocabulary.usage: 當事情不容易，但最後還是完成了時使用；後面接原形動詞。
options: He managed to happy with the new game.
I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
We managed to a big sandwich at lunch.
My phone managed to blue yesterday.
vocabulary.explanation: — 正確：雖然可能不容易，但成功完成了作業。
optionExplanations: — 錯誤：to 後面需要動詞，可以說 managed to be happy。
— 正確：雖然可能不容易，但成功完成了作業。
— 錯誤：to 後面缺少動詞，例如 make 或 eat。
— 錯誤：to 後面缺少動詞，且顏色不表示成功完成的行動。

vocabulary.usage: 談照顧家人、寵物，或負責處理事情時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Take care of」？
options: He takes care of his little sister after school.
I take care of my homework with a spoon.
She takes care of the rain so it will stop.
We take care of hungry by opening the door.
optionExplanations: — 正確：放學後照顧妹妹。
— 錯誤：用湯匙處理作業不符合正常語境。
— 錯誤：人不能照顧雨來讓它停下。
— 錯誤：hungry 是形容詞，不能這樣作為照顧的對象。

vocabulary.usage: 當你從幾個選擇中決定要做哪一個時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Make a decision」？
options: I made a decision in the fridge and it became cold.
My cat made a decision of blue yesterday.
We need to make a decision: take the bus or walk?
We made a decision because the clock was hungry.
vocabulary.explanation: — 正確：必須在搭公車和步行之間做選擇。
optionExplanations: — 錯誤：決定不是可以放進冰箱變冷的東西。
— 錯誤：of blue 不能清楚表達選擇了什麼。
— 正確：必須在搭公車和步行之間做選擇。
— 錯誤：時鐘不會肚子餓，原因不合理。

vocabulary.usage: 表示某物屬於某人，或自己覺得被某個團體接納時使用。
options: I belong my dinner every evening.
The shoes belong in happy because they are red.
We belong the rain on Mondays.
This bag belongs to my sister.
vocabulary.explanation: — 正確：用 belongs to 表示包包是姐姐或妹妹的。
optionExplanations: — 錯誤：belong 不能直接接 dinner 來表示吃晚餐。
— 錯誤：in happy 不表示一個合理的位置或團體。
— 錯誤：belong 不能這樣用來描述天氣。
— 正確：用 belongs to 表示包包是姐姐或妹妹的。

vocabulary.usage: 工作表現受到肯定，得到更高職位時使用。
options: She worked hard and got promoted to manager.
I got promoted when I bought a bigger lunch.
My bicycle got promoted because it has two wheels.
He got promoted his jacket on the wall.
vocabulary.explanation: — 正確：努力工作後升任經理。
optionExplanations: — 正確：努力工作後升任經理。
— 錯誤：買較大的午餐不表示工作升職。
— 錯誤：腳踏車不能得到工作職位。
— 錯誤：這不能表示把外套掛在牆上。

vocabulary.meaning: 支付帳單、負擔生活開銷
vocabulary.usage: 談支付水電、房租等帳單或工作賺錢負擔日常開支時使用。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「Pay the bills」？
options: She works at a shop to pay the bills.
We pay the bills with our singing voices only.
I pay the bills by putting them in my shoes.
My dog paid the bills by barking at the moon.
vocabulary.explanation: — 正確：靠商店工作所得支付生活開銷。
optionExplanations: — 正確：靠商店工作所得支付生活開銷。
— 錯誤：唱歌聲音本身通常不能用來直接支付帳單。
— 錯誤：把帳單放進鞋裡並不是付款。
— 錯誤：對月亮叫不能支付帳單。
